name: Budget Utilization (Query)
query:
SELECT
    bu.name AS "ID:Link/Budget Utilization:120",
    bu.state AS "State:Data:120",
    bu.city AS "City:Data:120",
    bu.financial_year AS "Financial Year:Data:140",
    bu.asm_name AS "ASM Name:Data:150",
    bu.period AS "Period:Data:100",
    ba.total_budget AS "Total Budget:Currency:120",
    bu.approved_amount AS "Approved Amount:Currency:150",
    bu.utilized_amount AS "Utilized Amount:Currency:150",
    (IFNULL(bu.utilized_amount, 0) / IFNULL(ba.total_budget, 1)) * 100
        AS "Utilization Percent:Percent:120",
    bu.activity_date AS "Activity Date:Date:120",
    bu.payment_type AS "Payment Type:Data:120",
    bu.remarks AS "Remarks:Text:200"
FROM `tabBudget Utilization` bu
LEFT JOIN `tabBudget Allocation` ba
    ON ba.state = bu.state
   AND ba.financial_year = bu.financial_year
   AND ba.asm_name = bu.asm_name
   AND ba.period = bu.period

  


ORDER BY
    bu.activity_date DESC;
